Fayrakh

Overview

Fayrakh is a magician of the Last Shelter who sees Zak’s journey as a chance to hurt enemies on the surface. He offers magical aid without disguising his taste for revenge. His work with Kehel can delay his departure, and he ultimately prefers the Shelter to life on Gipath. [1, 2, 3]

Recruitment and farewell

Fairakh offers magical help partly because travelling on the surface gives him chances for revenge. Zak asks him to avoid unjustified violence; the magician promises obedience against Zak’s enemies but reserves a different attitude toward his own. Work with Kehel can keep him at the Shelter for a time. His farewell, if he accompanies Zak to Gipath, declines settlement there because he prefers the Shelter and doubts his art would be appreciated on the remote allod. [1, 4, 3, 2]
